reviews.text: Our pool is clean and beautiful- our technician Harry has done a great job every week. He always listens to our concerns and addresses each one. We have a rather large pool and sometimes is a daunting task to keep it looking beautiful- can’t say enough about how Harry has worked diligently to make sure our pool looks its best!!
reviews.author: Beth Didier

reviews.text: My name is Barbara Horton and I live in Bedford.I’ve been a customer for quite a while. I was referred to you by my daughter And her husband.My husband used to take care of the pool but now it’s my responsibility. Actually it’s your responsibility. And thanks to Robert, who is such a wonderful, nice polite, considerate young Man, my pool is awesome! He always tells me what to do what not to do and what it needs and doesn’t need. No matter what kind of dumb question I may have, he always takes the time to explain everything to me. I.can rely on him and your company. So thank you Robert for a wonderful job!!
reviews.author: Barbara Horton

reviews.text: Marcus Power has done a great job servicing and giving advice on our pool. I would recommend clear choice for ongoing service and advice.
reviews.author: Shaune Corbett

reviews.text: We have NEVER been disappointed with Flower Mound Pool Care & Maintance. I highly recommend their services. Colby does a great job maintaining the pool weekly. Al has given excellent expert advice many times in the two years we have owner our home/pool. They are friendly, helpful and efficient. They do their jobs with excellence.
reviews.author: Lori Schneider

reviews.text: I have been a client of Clear Choice Pool Care for over 10 years and am very satisfied with their weekly services.  This service call was for a repair which was handled quickly and completely. The technician was very professional and knowledgeable.
reviews.author: Donna Fuccello

reviews.text:
I have been with Flower Mound Pool since I moved to Texas two years ago. They have been amazing.

In two years they have never missed an appointment.

We use them year round on a weekly basis.

If I ever have questions I get a quick response from them.

I have a lot of trees in my area and no matter how bad the leaves fall, the pool is completely clean after they come.

Most recently Colby has been taking care of my pool this summer. He is thorough and takes his time making sure our pool is good for the week. But that seems to be the case with whoever ends up coming here that week.

I would 100% recommend. Enjoy the clean pool pic with the pups : )
reviews.author: Michael G

reviews.text: Picked Clear Choice according to the reviews I read. Finding a good pool service is apparently harder than it should be. I’ve heard stories of service techs that are done within 15-20 minutes. I wanted someone thorough and worth my money. Reviews don’t lie. These guys absolutely spend the time your pool deserves. And they make sure it’s done right. If you have something wrong with your pool they give you an estimate and no pressure to go with them at all to have repairs done. They just inform you of the issues and it’s up to you to decide. Awesome company!! Would definitely recommend and I’m glad I found them. Jackson is our service tech and he’s great. Takes his time to explain things and doesn’t great job at everything. Thanks!!
reviews.author: D N

reviews.text: Top notch service, workmanship, and customer experience across the board. I’m super happy and impressed with everyone at Flower Mound Pool Care and am grateful to finally find a pool company who takes pride in their work with high expertise and execution. I’m switching my weekly service as well and looking forward to what it looks like getting to work with skilled, helpful, and reliable professionals!
reviews.author: Crystal Forbes

data.summary: The reviews appear highly authentic, with specific details, varied writing styles, and credible long-term customer relationships. The primary anomaly is the extremely low Google review count (8) compared to the high Angi count (1102), which suggests the company's review presence is concentrated on Angi. There is no evidence of review manipulation in the content itself. The lack of any negative reviews on the sampled platforms, while positive, is a minor point of investigation but not a red flag given the strong, detailed positive feedback.
fake_signals: Very low review volume on Google (8 reviews) for a company with 1100+ on Angi
All 8 Google reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
authentic_signals: Specific technician names (Harry, Robert, Colby, Marcus, Al)
Varied writing styles and personal anecdotes
Mentions of long-term relationships (10+ years, 5 years)
Positive BBB accreditation and A+ rating
data.discrepancy_explanation: Available ratings are consistent. Google shows a perfect 5.0, BBB shows an A+ with accreditation, and Angi shows a strong 4.4 with high volume. No contradictory low ratings were found.
